251: [edit] Sex is forbidden on Yom Kippur. Even touching one's wife is forbidden, as if she is in a state of menstrual impurity. Similarly, it is forbidden to share a bed with one's wife.
[edit] One who has a seminal emission on the night of Yom Kippur should worry the whole year. If he makes it through the year, he is assured that he will make it to the World to Come.
